G0002.d: Ἀαρών (Heb. אַהֲרוֹן), indecl. (in FlJ, -ῶνος), Aaron (Exo.4:14, al.): Luk.1:5, Act.7:40, Heb.5:4, 7:11, 9:4.† (AS)

G0051.d: ἀγνόημα, -τός, τό (ἀγνοέω), a sin of ignorance (so in π.; see MM, VGT, see word): Heb.9:7.† (AS)

G0052.d: ἄγνοια, -ας, ἡ (ἀγνοέω), ignorance : Act.3:17 17:30, Eph.4:18 (with sense of wilful blindness; cf. MM, VGT, see word), 1Pe.1:14.† (AS)

MM, VGT, see word). __2. holy, sacred, venerable (II Mac, l.with). __3. G0071.d: ἄγω, __1. to lead, bring, carry: with ace, before ἐπί, εἰς, ἕως, πρός and simple dative; metaphorically, to lead, guide, impel: Jhn.10:16 Rom.2:4, Heb.2:10, 2Ti.3:6, al. __2. to spend or keep a day: Luk.24:21, Act.19:38 __3. Intrans., to go: subjunc., ἄγωμεν, Mat.2:46, al. (Cramer, 61; MM, VGT, see word). (AS)

G0072.d: ἀγωγή, -ῆς, ἡ (ἄγω), __1. a carrying away. __2. a leading, guiding; metaphorically, training; hence, from the expression ἀ. τοῦ βίου, absol., conduct, way of life: 2Ti.3:10 (Cremer, 61; MM, VGT, see word). † (AS)

G0073.d: ἀγών, -ῶνος, ὁ (ἄγω), __1. a gathering, esp. for games. __2. a place of assembly. __3. a contest, struggle, trial; metaphorically (MM, VGT, see word), __(a) of the Christian life as a contest and struggle: Php.1:30, 1Th.2:2, 1Ti.6:12, 2Ti.4:7 Heb.12:1; __(b) solicitude, anxiety: Col.2:1. † (AS)

G0074.d: ἀγωνία, -ας, ἡ (ἀγών), __1. a contest, wrestling (Eur., Xen.). __2. Of the mind, great fear, agony, anguish (Dem., Arist.): Luk.22:44 (cf . Field, Notes, 77 f. ; Abbott, Essays, 101 f. ; MM, VGT, see word). † (AS)

G0075.d: ἀγωνίζομαι (ἀγών), __1. to contend for a prize: 1Co.9:25, __2. to fight, struggle, strive: Jhn.18:36; metaphorically (MM, VGT, see word). Col.1:29 4:12, 1Ti.4:10 6:12, 2Ti.4:7; with inf. (Field, Notes, 66), Luk.13:24 (Cremer, 609) † (AS)

G0076.d: Ἀδάμ, ὁ indecl. (Heb. אָדָם), Adam: Luk.3:38, Rom.5:14, 1Co.15:22,45, 1Ti.2:13,14 Ju 14. Christ ὁ ἔσχατος Ἀ., 1Co.15:45.† (AS)

G0077.d: ἀδάπανος, -ον (δαπάνη), without expense, free of charge: 1Co.9:18.† (AS)

G0079.d: ἀδελφή, -ῆς, ἡ (ἀδελφός), a sister: Mat.19:29, al.; metaphorically (MM, VGT, see word), of a member of the Christian community: Rom.16:1, 1Co.7:15 Jas.21:15, al. (AS)

G0080.d: ἀδελφός, -οῦ, ὁ (ἀ- copul., δελφύς, womb), in cl., a brother, born of the same parent or parents. [In LXX (Hort, Ja., 102f.), for אָח ;] __1. lit. of a brother (Gen.4:2, al.). __2. Of a neighbour (Lev.19:17). __3. Of a member of the same nation (Exo.2:14, Deu.15:3). In NT in each of these senses (1. Mat.1:2, al.; 2. Mat.7:3; 3. Rom.9:3) and also, __4. of a fellow-Christian: 1Co.1:1, Act.9:30.…

G0081.d: ἀδελφότης, -ητος, ἡ (ἀδελφός), __1. abstract, brotherhood, brotherly affection (LXX). __2. Concrete, the brotherhood, the Christian community: 1Pe.2:17 5:9 (MM, VGT, see word). † (AS)

G0082.d: ἄ-δηλος, -ον (δῆλος), __1. unseen, unobserved, not manifest (Ps, l.with): Luk.11:44. __2. uncertain, indistinct: 1Co.14:8. † (AS)

G0085.d: ἀδημονέω, -ῶ (on the derivation, see MM, VGT, see word), [in Aq.: Job.18:20; Sm.: Psa.60 (61):3 115:2 (116:11), Ecc.7:17(16), Eze.3:15 * ;] to be troubled, distressed (MM, l.with): Mat.26:37, Mrk.14:33, Php.2:26.† (AS)

G0086.d: ᾅδης, -ου, ὁ __1. in Hom., Hades (Pluto), the god of the underworld. __2. the abode of Hades, the underivorld; in NT, the abode of departed spirits, Hades: ἐν τ. ᾅ., Luk.16:23; εἰς ᾅ., Act.2:27,31; πύλαι ᾅδου, Mat.16:18; κλεῖς τοῦ ᾅ., Rev.1:18; metaphorically, ἕως ᾅ., Mat.11:23, Luk.10:15; personified, Rev.6:8 20:13,14 (Cremer, 67, 610; MM, VGT, see word). † (AS)

G0087.d: ἀ-διά-κριτος, -ον (διακρίνω), __1. not to be parted, mixed, undistinguishable (cf. Pr, l.with, and see Lft., Ignat. Eph., §3). __2. without uncertainty (Hort, in l., but see MM, VGT, see word): Jas.3:17. † (AS)

G0088.d: ἀδιάλειπτος, -ον (διαλείπω), unremitting, incessant: Rom.9:2, 2Ti.1:3. (For exx., see MM, VGT, see word) † (AS)

G0089.d: ἀδιαλείπτως (see supr.), adv., unremittingly, incessantly: Rom.1:9, 1Th.1:3 2:13 5:17.† (AS)

G0091.d: ἀδικέω, -ῶ (ἄδικος), __1. intrans., to be ἄδικος, do wrong, act wickedly or criminally: Act.25:11, 1Co.6:8, 2Co.7:12, Col.3:25, Rev.22:11; to do hurt, Rev.9:19. __2. Trans. __(a) to do some wrong: ὃ ἠδίκησεν, Col.3:25; to wrong some one, Mat.20:13, Act.7:26, 27 25:10, 2Co.7:2, Gal.4:12, Phm 18, 2Pe.2:13; pass., Act.7:24, 2Co.7:12; mid., 1Co.6:7 (suffer . . . to be wronged; WM, §38, 3; but see…

G0092.d: ἀδίκημα, -τος, τό (ἀδικέω), a wrong, injury, misdeed (MM, VGT, see word): Act.18:14 24:20, Rev.18:5.† (AS)

G0093.d: ἀδικία, -ας, ἡ (ἄδικος), __1. injustice: Luk.18:6, Rom.9:14. __2. unrighteousness, iniquity: Jhn.7:18, Act.8:23, Rom.1:18, 29 2:8 6:13, 2Ti.2:19, 1Jn.1:9 5:17; opposite to ἀλήθεια, 1Co.13:6, 2Th.2:12; to δικαιοσύνη ], Rom.3:5; ἀπάτη τῆς ἀ., 2Th.2:10; μισθὸς ἀδικίας, Act.1:18, 2Pe.2:13,15; ἐγράται τῆς ἀ., Luk.13:27; μαμωνᾶς τῆς ἀ., Luk.16:9; κόσμος τῆς ἀ., Jas.3:6; οἰκονόμος τῆς ἀ., Luk.16:8. __3.…

G0094.d: ἄδικος, -ον (δίκη), __1. unjust: Rom.3:5, Heb.6:10. __2. unrighteous, wicked: Luk.16:11 18:11, Act.24:15, 1Co.6:1,9 1Pe.3:18; opposite to δίκαιος, Mat.5:45; to εὐσεβής, 2Pe.2:9; to πιστός, Luk.16:10 (Cremer, 200). † (AS)

G0096.d: ἀ-δόκιμος, -ον, __1. of things (prop. of metals: LXX, ll. with), not standing the test, rejected: γῆ, Heb.6:8. __2. Of persons, rejected after testing, reprobate: Rom.1:28, 1Co.9:27, 2Co.13:5-7, 2Ti.3:8, Tit.1:16 (Cremer, 212). † (AS)

G0097.d: ἄδολος, -ον, __1. guileless (Pind., Thuc). __2. Of liquids (Æsch., Eur., and late prose writers), genuine, pure (in π. and in MGr. of wine, also of corn: MM, VGT, see word; Milligan, NTD, 77): of milk, metaphorically, 1Pe.2:2. † SYN.: ἀκέραιος (which see), ἄκακος, ἁπλοῦς. (AS)

G0098.d: Ἁδραμυντηνός (T, Rec. Ἀδραμυττηνός), -ή,-όν, of Adramyttium, a seaport of Mysia: Act.27:2.† (AS)

G0099.d: Ἁδρίας (T, Rec. Ἀδρίας), -ου, ὁ, the Adriatic sea, in later Greek usage extended to take in all the waters between Greece and Italy: Act.27:27.† (AS)

G0100.d: ἁδρότης, -τος, ἡ (ἁδρός, thick, well-grown), __1. thickness, vigour. __2. abundance, bounty: 2Co.8:20. † (AS)

G0101.d: ἀδυνατέω, -ῶ (ἀδύνατος), __1. Abbott-Smith omits this number to be unable (cl., Philo; π., see MM, VGT, see word). __2. In LXX and NT (Kennedy, Sources, 124; Hatch, Essays, 4; Field, Notes, 46 f.), to be impossible: Mat.17:20, Luk.1:37. † (AS)

G0102.d: ἀ-δύνατος, -ον, __1. of persons, unable, powerless: Act.14:8; figuratively Rom.15:1 (MM, VGT, see word). __2. Of things, impossible: Mat.19:26, Mrk.10:27, Luk.18:27, Rom.8:3, Heb.6:4,18 10:4 11:6. † (AS)

G0103.d: ᾄδω (Attic form of Ion. and poët. ἀείδω), to sing, __(a) intrans., with dative (MM, VGT, see word), of praise to God: Eph.5:19, Col.3:16 ; __(b) trans., with cogn. accusative: ᾠδὴν, Rev.5:9 14:3 15:3. † (AS)

G0104.d: ἀεί, adv., ever; __1. of continuous time, unceasingly, perpetually: Act.7:51, 2 Co.4.11; 6:10, Tit.1:12, Heb.3:10. __2. Of successive occurrences, on every occasion (MM, VGT, see word): 1Pe.3:15, 2Pe.1:12. † (AS)

G0105.d: ἀετός, -οῦ, ὁ, an eagle: Rev.4:7 8:13 (Rec. ἀγγέλου) 12:14. Where carrion is referred to, ἀ. is probably a vulture (cf. Job.39:30, Pro.30:17): Mat.24:28, Luk.17:37 (MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

G0106.d: ἄζυμος, -ον (ζύμη), unleavened: ἡ ἑορτὴ τῶν ἄ. (הַג הַמָצָּה), the paschal feast (also called τὰ ἄ., Mrk.14:1), Luk.22:1; ἡμέρα τῶν ἄ., Mat.26:17, Mrk.14:12, Luk.22:7; ἡμέραι, Act.12:3 20:6. Fig., of Christians, free from corruption: 1Co.5:7; exhorted to keep festival, ἐν ἀζύμοις (sc. ἄρτοις, λάγανοις, or, indefinitely, "unleavened elements"), ib. 8 (Cremer, 724).† (AS)

G0108.d: Ἄζωτος, -ου, ἡ (Heb., אַשְׁדּוֹד), Azotus, a Philistine city: Act.8:40.† (AS)

G0109.d: ἀήρ, ἀέρος, ὁ, in Hom., Hes., the lower air which surrounds the earth, as opposite to the purer αἰθήρ of the higher regions; generally, air (MM, VGT, see word): Act.22:23, 1Th.4:17, Rev.9:2 16:17; of the air as the realm of demons, Eph.2:2; ἀ. δέρειν, of striving to no purpose, 1Co.9:26; εἰς ἀ. λαλεῖν, of speaking without effect, not being understood, 1Co.14:9.† (AS)

G0110.d: ἀθανασία, -ας, ἡ (ἀ-θάνατος, undying; V. MM, VGT, see word), immortality: 1Co.15:53,54 1Ti.6:16 (cf. Cremer, 285 f.).† (AS)

G0111.d: ἀ-θέμιτος (late form of ἀθέμιστος, LS, MM, VGT, see word), -ον (θέμις, custom, right), __(a) of persons, lawless (III Mac, l.with); __(b) of things, lawless, unlawful: Act.10:28, 1Pe.4:3.† SYN.: see: ἄθεσμος. (AS)

G0112.d: ἄ-θεος, -ον, __1. in cl. __(a) slighting or denyiyig the gods (Plat.; cf. MM, VGT, see word); __(b) godless, ungodly (Pind.); __(with) abandoned by the gods (Soph.) __2. In the NT (cf. Lft. on Ign. ad Trail, §3), of the heathen, without God, not knowing God (Cremer, 281): Eph.2:12. † (AS)

G0113.d: ἄθεσμος, -ον (θεσμός, law, custom), lawless, esp. of those who violate the law of nature and conscience (cf. MM, VGT, see word): 2Pe.2:7 3:17.† SYN.: ἀθέμιτος, ἄνομος, κακός, πονηρός, φαῦλος (see Tr., Syn., §lxxiv; DCG, ii, 821b). (AS)

G0114.d: ἀθετέω, -ῶ (τίθημι), . __1. to set aside, disregard (in Gramm., to reject as spurious): διαθήκην , Gal.3:16; ἐντολήν , Mrk.7:9; νόμον . Heb.10:28; πίστιν , 1Ti.5:12. __2. to nullify, make void: Luk.7:30 (see Field, Notes, 59), 1Co.1:19, Gal.2:21. __3. to reject: Mrk.6:26 (Field, op. cit., 30), Lk 10:16, Jhn.12:48, I Th 48, Ju 8 (for exx. in π., see MM, VGT, see word). † (AS)

G0115.d: ἀθέτησις, -εως, ἡ (ἀθετέω), a disannulling, setting aside: Heb.7:18 9:26 (for similar usage in π., see Deiss., BS, 228 f.; MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

G0116.d: Ἀθῆναι, -ῶν, αἱ (plural because consisting of several parts), Athens: Act.17:15,16 18:1, 1Th.3:1.† (AS)

G0117.d: Athenian, of or from Athens , (Iliad by Homer), etc (ML)

G0118.d: ἀθλέω, -ῶ (in cl. also ἀθλεύω, ἆθλος, a contest, in war or in sport), to contend in games, wrestle, combat: 2Ti.2:5.† (AS)

G0119.d: ἄθλησις, -εως, ἡ (ἀθλέω), a contest, combat, esp. of athletes; figuratively, a struggle: Heb.10:32 (for exx., see MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

G0120.d: ἀθυμέω, -ῶ (ἄ-θυμος, without heart), to be disheartened: Col.3:21.† (AS)

G0121.d: ἀθῷος (Rec. wrongly, -ῶος; LS, see word; Mayser, 131), -ον (θωή, a penalty), __1. unpunished (MM, VGT, see word). __2. innocent: Mat.27:4 (WH, R, mg., δίκαιον) 27:24. (AS)

G0122.d: αἴγειος (WH, -γιος), -α, -ον (αἶξ, a goat), of a goat: Heb.11:37 (MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

G0123.d: αἰγιαλός, -οῦ, ὁ (on the derivation, see Boisacq, see word), the sea-shore, beach (cf. Field, Notes, 146; DCG, i, 175 f.; MM, VGT, see word): Mat.13:2,48 Jhn.21:4, Act.21:5 27:39,40.† (AS)

G0125.d: Αἴγυπτος, ου, ἡ, Egypt: Mat.2:13-15,19, Act.2:10 7:9-39, Heb.3:16 11:26,27; γῆ Αἴ., Act.7:40 13:17, Heb.8:9, Ju 5 (cf. Exo.5:12, al.); ἡ Αἴ., Act.7:11; figuratively, of Jerusalem as hostile to God, Rev.11:8.† (AS)

G0126.d: ἀΐδιος, -ον (ἀεί), everlasting (frequently in Inscr.; MM, VGT, see word): Rom.1:20, Ju 6.† SYN.: αἰώνιος, also frequently in Inscr. (Deiss., BS, 363 J. The etymological distinction between the meanings of the two words seems not to be retained in late Greek (see Thayer, see word, αἰώνιος; cf. Cremer, 79, 611). (AS)

G0127.d: αἰδώς (-όος), -οῦς, ἡ, a sense of shame, modesty: 1Ti.2:9 (for exx., see MM, VGT, see word).† SYN.: αἰσχύνη (see Thayer, 14; Tr., Syn., §xix; Cremer, 611 f.; CGT on I Ti, l.with). (AS)

G0128.d: .*Αἰθίοψ, -οπος, ὁ (αἴθω, to burn, ὤψ, face; i.e. swarthy), Ethiopian: Act.8:27.† (AS)

G0129.d: αἷμα, ατος, τό, blood. __1. In the ordinary sense: Mrk.5:25, Luk.8:43,44 22:44, Jhn.19:34, Act.15:20,29 21:25, Rev.8:7,8 11:6 16:3,4,6 19:13. __2. In special senses: __(a) of generation, origin, kinship (cl.): Jhn.1:13 (see MM, VGT, see word); __(b) as in OT (AR on Eph, l.with), in the phrase σάρξ καὶ αἷ. (αἷ. κ. σ.), to indicate human nature as opposite to God and created spirits: Mat.16:17,…

G0129G.d: αἷμα, ατος, τό, blood. __1. In the ordinary sense: Mrk.5:25, Luk.8:43,44 22:44, Jhn.19:34, Act.15:20,29 21:25, Rev.8:7,8 11:6 16:3,4,6 19:13. __2. In special senses: __(a) of generation, origin, kinship (cl.): Jhn.1:13 (see MM, VGT, see word); __(b) as in OT (AR on Eph, l.with), in the phrase σάρξ καὶ αἷ. (αἷ. κ. σ.), to indicate human nature as opposite to God and created spirits: Mat.16:17,…

G0129H.d: αἷμα, ατος, τό, blood. __1. In the ordinary sense: Mrk.5:25, Luk.8:43,44 22:44, Jhn.19:34, Act.15:20,29 21:25, Rev.8:7,8 11:6 16:3,4,6 19:13. __2. In special senses: __(a) of generation, origin, kinship (cl.): Jhn.1:13 (see MM, VGT, see word); __(b) as in OT (AR on Eph, l.with), in the phrase σάρξ καὶ αἷ. (αἷ. κ. σ.), to indicate human nature as opposite to God and created spirits: Mat.16:17,…

G0130.d: αἱματεκχυσία, -ας, ἡ (αἷμα, ἐκ, χέω), shedding of blood (Eccl.; Cremer, 71): Heb.9:22.† (AS)

G0131.d: αἱμορροέω, (αἷμα, ῥέω), to lose blood, suffer from a flow of blood (Hipp.): Mat.9:20.† (AS)

G0133.d: αἴνεσις, -εως, ἡ (αἰνέω), praise (Eccl.): θυσία αἰνέσεως (Lev.7:12, זֶבַח תּוֹדָה), Heb.13:15.† (AS)

G0134.d: αἰνέω, -ῶ (αἶνος), poët., Ion. and late prose (MM, VGT, see word) for cl. ἐπαινέω, to praise: with accusative, τ. θεόν, Luk.2:13,20 19:37 24:53, Act.2:47 3:8,9, Rom.15:11; with dative, τ. Θεῷ (Jer.20:13, al. for הִלֵּל לְ; see Field, Notes, 245), Rev.19:5.† SYN.: ἐξομολογέω, εὐλογέω, εὐχαριστέω, μακαρίζω (see DCG, i, 211). (AS)

G0135.d: αἴνιγμα, -ατος, τό (αἰνίσσομαι, to speak in riddles; αἰνός = δεινός, dread, strange), a dark saying, riddle: 1Co.13:12 (cf. Nu, l.with).† (AS)

G0136.d: αἶνος, ου, ὁ, poët, and Ion., __1. = μῦθος, a tale (Horn., al.). __2. = Att. ἔπαινος, praise (Horn., al.): Mat.21:16 (LXX), Luk.18:43. __3. In π., a decree (MM, VGT, see word). † (AS)

G0137.d: Αἰνών, ἡ, indecl. (cf. Heb.עַיִן, a spring), Aenon: Jhn.3:23.† (AS)

G0138.d: αἱρέω, to take; Mid., -ομαι (M, Pr., 158 f.; MM, VGT, see word), to choose: Php.1:22, 2Th.2:13, Heb.11:25. (Cf. ἀν-, ἀφ-, δι-, ἐξ-, καθ-, περι-, προ-αιρέω.) † (AS)

G0139.d: αἵρεσις, -εως, ἡ (αἱρέω, -ομαι), __1. capture. __2. choosing, choice (see MM, VGT, see word). __3. that which is chosen, hence, opinion; esp. a peculiar opinion, heresy: 1Co.11:19, Gal.5:20, 2Pe.2:1 R, txt. __4. In late writers (MM, VGT), of a set of persons professing particular principles or opinions, a school, sect, party, faction: Act.5:17 15:5 24:5,14 26:5 28:22, I Co, Ga, II Pe, l.with, R,…

G0140.d: αἱρετίζω, = αἱρέομαι (Hipp., Inscr.), to choose: Mat.12:18 (LXX, ἀντιλήμψομαι).† (AS)

G0141.d: αἱρετικός, -ή, όν (αἱρέομαι), __1. capable of choosing (Plat.). __2. causing division, heretical, factious (Cremer, 614): as subst., Tit.3:10. † (AS)

G0142.d: αἴρω, __1. to raise, take up, lift or draw up: Jhn.8:59 11:41, Act.27:17, al. __2. to bear, carry: Mat.4:6 16:24, al. __3. to bear or take away, carry off, remove: Mat.21:21, Jhn.19:31, 1Co.5:12 6:15 (see Lft., Notes, 216), al.; of the taking away sin by Christ, Jhn.1:29, 1Jn.3:5. (Cf. ἀπ᾽, ἐξ-, ἐπ-, μετ-, συν-, ὑπερ-αίρω). For exx. from π., see MM, VGT, see word) (AS)

G0143.d: αἰσθάνομαι, to perceive: withaccusative of thing(s) (Bl., §36, 5; MM, VGT, see word), Luk.9:45 (Cremer, 619 f.).† (AS)

G0144.d: αἴσθησις, -εως, ἡ (αἰσθάνομαι), perception (MM, VGT, see word): Php.1:9.† SYN.: ἐπίγνωσις, which see (cf. Cremer, 620). (AS)

G0145.d: αἰσθητήριον, -ου, τό (αἰσθάνομαι), sense, organ of perception: Heb.5:14 (MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

G0146.d: αἰσχροκερδής, -ες (αἰσχρός, κέρδος), greedy of base gains: 1Ti.3:3,8 Abbot-Smith omits 1Ti.3:3, Tit.1:7.† (AS)

G0147.d: αἰσχροκερδῶς, adv., from eagerness for base gain: 1Pe.5:2 (here only).† (AS)

G0148.d: αἰσχρολογία, -ας, ἡ (αἰσχρός, λέγω), abusive language, abuse (Lft., ICC, in l.; MM, VGT, see word): Col.3:8.† (AS)

G0150.d: αἰσχρός, -ά, όν (αἶσχος, shame, disgrace), base, shameful: 1Co.11:6 14:35, Eph.5:12, Tit.1:11 (MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

G0152.d: αἰσχύνη, -ης, ἡ (αἶσχος, shame, disgrace), shame (MM, VGT, see word): subjectively, Luk.14:19, 2Co.4:2; objectively, Php.3:19, Heb.12:2; as something to be ashamed of, Rev.3:18; pl. (Bl., §32, 6), shameful deeds, Ju 13.† SYN.: αἰδώς, which see (AS)

G0153.d: αἰσχύνω (αἶσχος, shame), __1. to disfigure (Hom.). __2. to dishonour (Pro.29:15). __3. to make ashamed (Sir.13:7). Pass., to be put to shame, be ashamed: 2Co.10:8; Php.1:20, 1Pe.4:16, 1Jn.2:28; with inf. (M, Pr., 205), Luk.16:3 (cf. ἐπ- (-ομαι), κατ- αἰσχύνω). † (AS)

G0154.d: αἰτέω, -ῶ, to ask, request: absol., Mat.7:7, Jas.1:6; with accusative of person(s), Mat.5:42, Luk.6:30; with accusative of thing(s), before ἀπό, Mat.20:20, 1Jn.5:15; id. before παρά, Act.3:2, Jas.1:5; with dupl. accusative Mat.7:9, Mrk.6:22, Jhn.16:23. Mid. (on the distinction bet. mid. and act., see M, Pr., 160): absol., Mrk.15:8, Jhn.16:26, Jas.4:3; with accusative of thing(s), Mat.14:7,…

G0155.d: αἴτημα, -ατος, τό (αἰτέω), that which has been asked for, a petition, request: Luk.23:24, Php.4:6, Jhn.5:15.† SYN.: see: δέησις. (AS)

G0156.d: αἰτία, -ας, ἡ, __1. cause, reason, occasion, case: Mat.19:3, Luk.8:47, Act.10:21 22:24 28:20, 2Ti.1:6,12, Tit.1:13, Heb.2:11 ; εἰ οὕτως ἐστιν ἡ αἰ. (cf. Lat. si ita res se habet, and see MM. VGT, see word), Mat.19:10. __2. In forensic sense, __(a) accusation: Act.25:18,27; __(b) cause for punishment, crime: Mat.27:37, Mrk.15:26, Jhn.18:38 19:4,6, Act.13:28 23:28 28:18. † SYN.: ἔλεγχος, a charge,…

G0157.d: αἰτίωμα (Rec. αἰτίαμα, the usual form; see MM, VGT, see word), -τος, τό (αἰτιάομαι, αἰτία), a charge, accusation: Act.25:7.† (AS)

G0159.d: αἴτιος, -α, ὁ (αἰτία), __1. causative of, responsible for; as subst., ὁ αἰ., the cause, author: Heb.5:9; τὸ αἰ., the cause, Act.19:40. __2. blameworthy, culpable; as subst., ὁ αἰ., the culprit, the accused (Lat. reus); τὸ αἰ. (= αἰτία, 3), the crime, Luk.23:4,14,22. † (AS)

G0160.d: αἰφνίδιος (in Lk, l.with, ἐφν- WH; see M, Pr., 35), -ον (αἴφνης = ἄφνως, suddenly), sudden, unexpected: Luk.21:34, 1Th.5:3.† (AS)

G0161.d: αἰχμαλωσία -ας, ἡ (αἰχμάλωτος), captivity (Diod., al.): Rev.13:10; pl., abstr. for concr., = αἰχμάλωτοι, Eph.4:8 (LXX).† (AS)

G0162.d: αἰχμαλωτεύω (αἰχμάλωτος), = αἰχμαλωτίζω, which see, to lead captive: Eph.4:8 (LXX).† (AS)

G0163.d: αἰχμαλωτίζω (αἰχμάλωτος), in late writers = cl. αἰχμάλωτον ποιῶ (ἄγω), to take or lead captive: before εἰς, Luk.21:24 (cf. Tob.1:10); metaphorically, Rom.7:23, 2Co.10:5, 2Ti.3:6.† (AS)

G0164.d: αἰχμάλωτος, -ον (αἰχμή, a spear, ἁλίσκομαι, to be taken), captive: Luk.4:18 (LXX).† (AS)

G0165G.d: αἰών, -ῶνος, ὁ, __1. in cl., like Lat. aevum (LS, MM, VGT, see word), a space of time, as, a lifetime, generation, period of history, an indefinitely long period; in NT of an indefinitely long period, an age, eternity, usually with prep. (MM, VGT); __(a) of the past: ἀπ᾽ αἰ. (cf. Heb. מֵעוֹלָם), Luk.1:70; __(b) of the future: εἰς τ. αἰ. (cf. לְעוֹלָם), forever, Mat.21:19; id., with neg., never,…

G0165H.d: αἰών, -ῶνος, ὁ, __1. in cl., like Lat. aevum (LS, MM, VGT, see word), a space of time, as, a lifetime, generation, period of history, an indefinitely long period; in NT of an indefinitely long period, an age, eternity, usually with prep. (MM, VGT); __(a) of the past: ἀπ᾽ αἰ. (cf. Heb. מֵעוֹלָם), Luk.1:70; __(b) of the future: εἰς τ. αἰ. (cf. לְעוֹלָם), forever, Mat.21:19; id., with neg., never,…

G0166.d: αἰώνιος, -ον (as usual in Attic), also -α, -ον. 2Th.2:16, Heb.9:12; (αἰών), age-long, eternal, __(a) of that which is without either beginning or end: Rom.16:26, Heb.9:14; __(b) of that which is without beginning: Rom.16:25, 2Ti.1:9, Tit.1:2; __(with) of that which is without end (MM, VGT, see word): σκηναί, Luk.16:9 οἰκία, 2Co.5:1; διαθήκη, Heb.13:20; εὐαγγέλιον, Rev.14:6; παράκλησις, 2Th.2:16;…

G0167.d: ἀκαθαρσία, -ας, ἡ (ἀκάθαρτος), uncleanness, impurity, __(a) physical (MM, VGT, see word): Mat.23:27; __(b) moral: Rom.1:24 6:19, 2Co.12:21, Gal.5:19, Eph.4:19 5:3, Col.3:5, 1Th.2:3 4:7. † (AS)

G0168.d: ἀκαθάρτης, -τος, ἡ, uncleanness: Rev.17:4, Rec. (for τ. ἀκάθαρτα).† (AS)

G0169.d: ἀκάθαρτος, -ον (ἀ- neg., καθαίρω), unclean, impure; __(a) physically (LS, MM, VGT, see word); __(b) ceremonially: Act.10:14,28 11:8, 1Co.7:14, 2Co.6:17, Rev.18:2; __(with) morally: Eph.5:5, Rev.17:4; with πνεῦμα, as always in Gosp., Mat.10:1 12:43, Mrk.1:23,26,27 3:11,30 5:2,8,13 6:7 7:25 9:25, Luk.4:33,36 6:18 8:29 9:42 11:24, Act.5:16 8:7, Rev.16:13 (cf. Cremer, 320). † (AS)

G0170.d: ἀκαιρέομαι, -οῦμαι (ἄκαιρος, unseasonable), to have no opportunity (opposite to εὐκαιρέω): Php.4:10.† (AS)

G0171.d: ἀκαίρως, adv. (ἄκαιρος, unseasonable), out of season, unseasonably: opposite to εὐκαίρως (which see), 2Ti.4:2 (cf. Cremer, 740; MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

G0172.d: ἄκακος, -ον, __(a) as in cl. (Æsch., Plat., al.), of persons, simple, guileless: Rom.16:18, Heb.7:26 (cf. Cremer, 327); __(b) of things, undamaged (? MM, VGT, see word). † (AS)

G0173.d: ἄκανθα, -ης, ἡ (ἀκή, a point), a prickly plant, thorn, brier; in NT always pl.: Mat.7:16 13:7,22 27:29, Mrk.4:7,18, Luk.6:44 8:7,14, Jhn.19:2, Heb.6:8 (see MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

G0174.d: ἀκάνθινος, -ον (ἄκανθα), __1. of thorns: Mrk.15:17, Jhn.19:5. __2. of acantha-wood (Hdt.; π. ap. MM, VGT, see word). † (AS)

G0175.d: ἄ-καρπος, -ον, unfruitful, barren: figuratively, Mat.13:22, Mrk.4:19, 1Co.14:14, Eph.5:11, Tit.3:14, 2Pe.1:8, Ju 12.† (AS)

G0176.d: ἀ-κατά-γνωστος, -ον (καταγινώσκω), not open to just rebuke, irreprehensible: Tit.2:8 (see Cremer, 676; and for other exx., MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

G0178.d: ἀ-κατά-κριτος, -ον (κατακρίνω), __1. uncondemned (EV): Act.16:37, 22:25. __2. = cl. ἄκριτος, without trial, not yet tried (MM, VGT, see word) Ac, ll. cc. † (AS)

G0180.d: ἀκατάπαυστος, -ον (καταπαύω), that cannot cease, not to be restrained: with genitive of thing(s), 2Pe.2:14, T, Tr. txt.† (AS)

G0181.d: ἀκαταστασία, -ας, ἡ (ἀκατάστατος), instability (MM, VGT, see word); hence, confusion, tumult: 1Co.14:33, Jas.3:16; pl. (Bl., §32, 6), Luk.21:9, 2Co.6:5, 12:20 (Polyb., al.; see Cremer, 739).† (AS)

G0183.d: ἀκατάσχετος, -ον (κατέχω), that cannot be restrained: Jas.3:8 Rec. (for -στατος, which see).† (AS)

G0184.d: § Akeldama dama (Proper name) (traditionally located south of the valley of Hinnom), "field of blood"

G0185.d: ἀκέραιος, -ον (κεράννυμι), unmixed, pure, hence, metaphorically (cf. MM, VGT, see word), guileless, simple: Mat.10:16, Rom.16:19, Php.2:15.† SYN.: ἄδολος, ἄκακος, ἁπλοῦς (cf. Ellic. on Phl., l.with; Tr., Syn., §lvi). (AS)

G0186.d: ἀκλινής, -ές (κλίνω), unbending, firm: metaphorically (MM, VGT, see word). Heb.10:23.† (AS)

G0187.d: ἀκμάζω (ἀκμήν), to be at the prime; of produce of the ground, to be ripe (Thuc.): Rev.14:18 (MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

G0188.d: ἀκμήν, accusative of ἀκμή, a point, used as adv., at the present point of time, even now, even yet: Mat.15:16.† (AS)

G0189.d: ἀκοή, -ῆς, ἡ (ἀκούω), __1. hearing, the sense of hearing: 1Co.12:17, 2Pe.2:8; "Hebraic dative," ἀκοῇ ακούειν (frequently in LXX; V. M, Pr., 14, 75), Mat.13:14, Act.28:26. __2. organ of hearing, the ear (Arist., al.; MM, VGT, see word): 2Ti.4:3-4; pl., Mrk.7:35, Luk.7:1, Act.17:20, Heb.5:11. __3. a thing heard, i.e., __(a) a message, teaching: Jhn.12:38 and Rom.16:16,17" (LXX), Gal.3:2,5 R, mg.;…

G0190.d: ἀκολουθέω, -ῶ (ἀκόλουθος, following; ἀ- cop., κέλευθος, poët., away), to accompany, follow: Mat.4:25, al. Metaphorical, of discipleship: Mat.9:9, Mrk.9:38, Jhn.12:26, al. Absol.: Mat.18:10; more freq., with dative (cl.), Mat.8:1, al.; before μετά, with genitive, (cl.; Eutherford, N.Phr., 458 f.), Luk.9:49; ὀπίσω, with genitive (Heb. הָלַךְ אָהֲרֵי), Mat.10:38 (cf. ἐξ-, ἐπ-, κατ-, παρ-,…

G0191.d: ἀκούω, to hear, listen, attend, perceive by hearing, comprehend by hearing. __1. Intrans.: Mrk.4:3 7:37, Jas.2:5, Rev.2:7, al.; τ. ὠσίν, Mat.13:15 (LXX); with cogn. dative, ακοῇ ἀ. (see: ἀκοή), Mat.13:14, Act.28:26" (LXX) ; ὁ ἔχων ὦτα (οὖς) ἀκούειν, ἀκουσάτω, Mat.11:15, Mrk.4:23, Rev.2:7, al. __2. Trans., prop. with accusative of thing(s), of thing heard, genitive of person(s), from whom heard…

G0192.d: ἀκρασία, -ας, ἡ (ἀκρατής, which see), in Arist. and later writers = ἀκράτεια (Lft., Notes, 222 f.), want of power, hence want of self-control, incontinence: Mat.23:25, 1Co.7:5.† (AS)

G0193.d: ἀκρατής, -ές (κράτος), __(a) powerless, impotent; __(b) in moral sense, lacking self-control, incontinent: 2Ti.3:3.† (AS)

G0195.d: ἀκρίβεια, -ας, ἡ (ἀκριβής), exactness, precision (for exx., see MM, VGT, see word): Act.22:3.† (AS)

G0196.d: ἀκριβής, -ές exact, precise, careful, of things and persons: superl., Act.26:5.† (AS)

G0197.d: ἀκριβῶς adv. (ἀκριβής), with exactness, carefully: Mat.2:8, Luk.1:3, Act.18:25, Eph.5:15, 1Th.5:2 (M, Th., in l). Compar., ἀκριβέστερον (Milligan, NTD, 111; MM, VGT, see word), Act.18:26 23:15, 20 24:22.† (AS)

G0198.d: ἀκριβόω, -ῶ (ἀκριβής), [in Aq.: Isa.30:8 49:16 * ;] to enquire with exactness, learn carefully: Mat.2:7, 16 (for similar ex., see MM, VGT, sv.).† (AS)

G0199.d: ἀκριβῶς adv. (ἀκριβής), with exactness, carefully: Mat.2:8, Luk.1:3, Act.18:25, Eph.5:15, 1Th.5:2 (M, Th., in l). Compar., ἀκριβέστερον (Milligan, NTD, 111; MM, VGT, see word), Act.18:26 23:15, 20 24:22.† (AS)

G0200.d: ἀκρίς, -ίδος, ἡ a locust: Mat.3:4, Mrk.1:6, Rev.9:3, 7.† (AS)

G0201.d: ἀκροατήριον, -ου, τό (ἀκροάομαι, to listen) a place of audience: Act.25:23 (Plut.).† (AS)

G0202.d: ἀκροατής, οῦ, ὁ (see supr.) a hearer: Rom.2:13, Jas.1:22, 23, 25.† (AS)

G0203.d: ἀκροβυστία, -ας, ή (perh. an Alexandrian form of cl. ἀκροποσθία; cf. MM, VGT, see word) the prepuce, foreskin (LXX), hence abstr., uncircumcision: Act.11:3, Rom.2:25-27 3:30 4:10-12, 1Co.7:18-19, Gal.5:6 6:15, Col.2:13 3:11 By meton., the uncircumcised: Rom.4:9, Gal.2:7, Eph.2:11.† (AS)

G0204.d: ἀκρο-γωνιαῖος, -αία, -αῖον (ἄκροι, γωνία, an angle) = Attic γωνιαῖος (frequently in Inscr.; MM, VGT, see word ἀ.), at the extreme angle: ὁ ἀ., the corner foundation stone, Eph.2:20, 1Pe.2:6.† (AS)

G0205.d: ἀκροθίνιον, -ου, τό (ἄκρος, θίς, a heap), prop., the top of a heap, hence, in pl., __1. first-fruits (Xen.; MM, VGT, see word). __2. In war, the choicest spoils (cf. Hdt., viii, 121 f.): Heb.7:4. † (AS)

G0206.d: ἄκρος, -α, -ον highest, extreme; as subst., τὸ ἄ., the top, extremity: Mrk.13:27, Luk.16:24, Heb.11:21; pl. (cf. MM, VGT, see word), Mat.24:31.† (AS)

G0207.d: Ἀκύλας, -ου (and -α; MM, VGT, see word), ὁ (Lat.), Aquila: Act.18:2, 18 18:26, Rom.16:3, 1Co.16:19, 2Ti.4:19.† (AS)

G0208.d: ἀκυρόω, -ῶ (κῦρος, authority), to revoke, invalidate (MM, VGT, see word): Mat.15:6, Mrk.7:13, Gal.3:17 (Plut.).† (AS)

G0209.d: ἀκωλύτως adv. (κωλύω), [in Sm.: Job.34:31 * ;] without hindrance (so frequently in legal documents; MM, VGT, see word): Act.28:31.† (AS)

G0210.d: ἀκων (Attic contr. for ἀέκων), -ουα, -ον (ἀ- neg., ἅκων, willing), unwilling: 1Co.9:17.† (AS)

G0211.d: ἀλάβαστρον, -ου, τό (also -ος, ὁ, ἡ; colloq. and κοινή for ἀλάβαστος), a box of alabaster (ἀλαβαστίτης) for ointment: Mat.26:7, Mrk.14:3, Luk.7:37 (see DCG, i, 41b; MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

G0212.d: ἀλαζονία(Rec. -εία, the earlier form), -ας, ἡ (ἀλαζών), the character of an ἀλαζών, boastfulness, vainglory, vaunting: Jas.4:16 (Mayor, in l), 1Jn.2:16.† (AS)

G0213.d: ἀλαζών, -όνος, ὁ, ἡ (ἄλη, wandering) prop, a vagabond, hence, an impostor, a boaster: Rom.1:30, 2Ti.3:2.† SYN.: ὐβριστής, ὑπερήφανος (see Tr., Syn., § xxix; Lft., Notes, 256) (AS)

G0214.d: ἀλαλάζω (onomat. from the battle-cry ἀλαλά), prop, to raise a war-cry, shout with triumph or joy; rarely of grief, to wail: Mrk.5:38 (cf. Jer.4:8); of a cymbal, ἀλαλάζον (RV. clanging), 1Co.13:1 (cf. ὀλολύζω).† (AS)

G0215.d: ἀ-λάλητος, -ον (λαλέω), inexpressible, not to be uttered: Rom.8:26.† (AS)

G0217.d: ἅλας (T, ἅλα), -ατος, τό, late form of cl. ἅλς, -ος, ὁ (MM, VGT, see word), salt, lit, and figuratively: Mat.5:13, Mrk.9:50 Luk.14:34; like cl. ἅλες, wit, of wisdom and grace in speech: Col.4:6.† (AS)

G0218.d: ἀλείφω (cf. λίπος, oil), to anoint, festally or in homage: with accusative of thing(s) or of person(s), Mat.6:17, Jhn.12:3, Mrk.16:1; before dative, ἐλαίῳ, Mrk.6:13, Jas.5:14; μύρῳ, Luk.7:38, 46, Jhn.11:2.† SYN.: χρίω, μυρίζω (against the distinction made bet. ἀ. and χ. in Tr., Syn., § 38, see MM, VGT, see word, ἀ.) (AS)

G0219.d: ἀλεκτοροφωνία, -ας, ἡ (ἀλέκτωρ, φωνή), cock-crowing, i.e. the third watch in the night: Mrk.13:35.† (AS)

G0220.d: ἀλέκτωρ, -ορος, ὁ (poët. form of ἀλεκτρυών; see MM, VGT, see word), a cock: Mat.26:34, Mrk.14:30, 68 14:72 Luk.22:34, 60-61, Jhn.13:38 18:27.† (AS)

G0222.d: Ἀλεξανδρινός (Rec. -δρῖνο; see Kühner3, II, 296), -ή, -όν, Alexan­drian: Act.27:6 28:11.† (AS)

G0223.d: Ἀλέξανδρος, -ου, ὁ, Alexander __1. Son of Simon of Cyrene: Mrk.15:21 __2. A kinsman of the High Priest: Act.4:6. __3. A certain Jew: Act.19:33. __4. A coppersmith: 1Ti.1:20. __5. Perh. = 4 (see Ellic. on I Ti, l.with): 2Ti.4:14. † (AS)

G0223G.d: Ἀλέξανδρος, -ου, ὁ, Alexander __1. Son of Simon of Cyrene: Mrk.15:21 __2. A kinsman of the High Priest: Act.4:6. __3. A certain Jew: Act.19:33. __4. A coppersmith: 1Ti.1:20. __5. Perh. = 4 (see Ellic. on I Ti, l.with): 2Ti.4:14. † (AS)

G0223I.d: Ἀλέξανδρος, -ου, ὁ, Alexander __1. Son of Simon of Cyrene: Mrk.15:21 __2. A kinsman of the High Priest: Act.4:6. __3. A certain Jew: Act.19:33. __4. A coppersmith: 1Ti.1:20. __5. Perh. = 4 (see Ellic. on I Ti, l.with): 2Ti.4:14. † (AS)

G0223J.d: Ἀλέξανδρος, -ου, ὁ, Alexander __1. Son of Simon of Cyrene: Mrk.15:21 __2. A kinsman of the High Priest: Act.4:6. __3. A certain Jew: Act.19:33. __4. A coppersmith: 1Ti.1:20. __5. Perh. = 4 (see Ellic. on I Ti, l.with): 2Ti.4:14. † (AS)

G0224.d: ἄλευρον, -ου, τό (ἀλεύω, to grind), real: Mat.13:33, Luk.13:21.† (AS)

G0225.d: ἀλήθεια, -ας, ἡ (ἀληθής), truth (see DB, iv, 818f.). __1. Objectively, "the reality lying at the basis of an appearance; the manifested, veritable essence of a matter" (Cremer, 86): Rom.9:1, al.; of religious truth, Rom.1:25, al.; esp. of Christian doctrine, Gal.2:5, al.; ἀ. θεοῦ, Rom.15:8. __2. Subjectively, truthfulness, truth, not merely verbal (cl.), but sincerity and integrity of character:…

G0226.d: ἀληθεύω (ἀληθής), to speak the truth (R, mg., deal truly; Field, Notes, 192): Gal.4:16, Eph.4:15.† (AS)

G0227.d: ἀληθής, -ές (λήθω = λανθάνω, hence primarily, unconcealed, manifest; hence, actual, real), __(a) of things, true, conforming to reality: Jhn.4:18 5:31-32 6:55 (= ἀληθινός, which see) Jhn.8:13-14, 17 10:41 19:35 21:24, Act.12:9, Php.4:8, Tit.1:13, 1Pe.5:12, 2Pe.2:22, 1Jn.2:6, 3Jn.12; __(b) of persons, truthful: Mat.22:16, Mrk.12:14, Jhn.3:33 7:18 8:26, Rom.3:4, 2Co.6:8.† SYN.: ἀληθινός, real,…

G0228.d: ἀληθινός, -ή, -όν (ἀληθής), true, in the sense of real, ideal, genuine: Luk.16:11 Jhn.1:9 4:23, 37 6:32 7:28 8:16 15:1 17:3 19:35, 1Th.1:9, Heb.8:2 9:24 10:22, 1Jn.2:8 Jn 5:20, Rev.3:7, 14 6:10 15:3 16:7 19:2; = ἀληθής, Rev.19:9 21:5 22:6 (MM, VGT, see word).† SYN.: ἀληθής, q.v (AS)

G0229.d: ἀλήθω (κοινή form of the Attic ἀλέω), to grind: Mat.24:41, Luk.17:35.† (AS)

G0231.d: ἁλεεύς (Rec. ἁλιεύς, the older form; WH, App., 151, -έως, ὁ (ἅλς, the sea) a fisherman: Mat.4:18, 19, Mrk.1:16, 17, Luk.5:2 (AS)

G0232.d: ἁλιεύω (ἁλιεύς), to fish: Jhn.21:3 (MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

G0233.d: ἁλίζω (ἅλς), to salt, season with salt: Mat.5:13, Mrk.9:49.† (AS)

G0234.d: ἀλίσγημα, -τος, τό (late ἀλισγέω, to pollute) pollution: Act.15:20.† (AS)

G0235.d: ἀλλά (ἀλλ᾽ usually bef. α and υ, often bef. ε and η, rarely bef. ο and ω, never bef. ι; Tdf., Pr., 93 f.; WH, App., 146), adversative particle, stronger than δέ; prop. neuter pl. of ἄλλος, used adverbially, with changed accent; hence prop. otherwise, on the other hand (cf. Rom.3:31); __1. opposing a previous negation, but: οὐ (μὴ) . . . ἀ., Mat.5:15, 17 Mrk.5:39, Jhn.7:16, al.; rhetorically…

G0236.d: ἀλλάσσω (ἄλλος), __1. to change: Act.6:14, Gal.4:20. __2. to transform: 1Co.15:51-52, Heb.1:12. __3. to exchange: with accusative, before ἐν (= בְּ, Psa.106:20) instead of simple genitive (Bl., § 36, 8), Rom.1:23 (cf. ἀπ-, δι-, κατ-, ἀπο-κατ-, μετ-, συν-αλλάσσω; see MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

G0237.d: ἀλλαχόθεν adv. (ἀλλος), = ἀλλοθεν (seeMM, VGT, see word) from another place: Jhn.10:1.† (AS)

G0238.d: ἀλληγορέω, -ῶ (ἄλλος, ἀγορεύω) to speak allegorically (Cremer, 96 ff.): Gal.4:24.† (AS)

G0239.d: ἁλληλουιά (Rec. ἀλληλούϊα; Heb. הָלַל יָהּ, praise the Lord), hallelujah, alleluia: Rev.19:1, 3-4 19:6.† (AS)

G0240.d: ἀλλήλων (genitive pl.), dative -οις, -αις, accusative -ους, -ας, -α (no nom.), recipr. pron. (ἄλλος), of one another, mutually: Mat.25:32, Mrk.4:41, Jhn.13:22, al. (AS)

G0241.d: ἀλλογενής, -ές (ἄλλος, γένος), of another race, a foreigner ( = ἀλλόφυλος; Cremer, 150; MM, VGT, see word): Luk.17:18.† (AS)

G0242.d: ἅλλομαι to leap: Act.3:8 14:10; of water, to spring up, Jhn.4:14 (MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

G0243.d: ἄλλος, -η, -ο, (cf. Lat. alius, Eng. else), other, another: absol., Mat.20:3, al.; ἄ. δέ, 1Co.3:10 12:8; pl., Mrk.6:15; attached to a noun, Mat.2:12 4:21, al.; with art., ὁ ἄ., the other, Mat.5:39, Jhn.19:32 (Bl., §47, 8); οἱ ἄ., the others, the rest, Jhn.20:25, 1Co.14:29; ἄ. πρὸς ἄλλον = πρὸς ἀλλήλους (BL, §48, 10), Act.2:12; ἄλλ᾽ (i.e. ἄλλο) ἤ (Bl., §77, 13), Luk.12:51; before πλήν, Mrk.12:32;…

G0244.d: ἀλλοτρι-επίσκοπος (Rec. ἀλλοτριοεπ-), -ου, ὁ one who meddles in things alien to his calling: 1Pe.4:15 (see ICC, in l; Deiss., BS, 224-4; MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

G0245.d: ἀλλότριος, -α, -ον (ἄλλος), __1. be-longing to another, not one's own (opposite to ἴδιος): Luk.16:12, Rom.14:4 15:20 (Field, Notes, 165 f.), 2Co.10:15-16, 1Ti.5:22, Heb.9:25. __2. foreign, strange, alien (opposite to οἰκεῖος; see MM, VGT, see word): Mat.17:25-26, Jhn.10:5, Act.7:6, Heb.11:9, 34.† (AS)

G0246.d: ἀλλόφυλος, -ον (ἄλλος, φῦλον, a tribe), foreign, of another race (MM, VGT, see word); as opposite to a Jew, a Gentile: Act.10:28.† (AS)

G0248.d: ἀλοάω, -ῶ (ἅλως, see: ἅλων; and cf. MM, VGT, see word), to thresh: 1Co.9:9 9:13; 1Ti.5:18.† (AS)

G0249.d: ἄ-λογος, -ον __1. without reason, irrational: ζῷα, 2Pe.2:12, Ju 10. __2. contrary to reason: Act.25:27 (see MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

G0250.d: ἀλόη, -ης, ἡ the aloe, aloes (the powder of a fragrant wood): Jhn.19:39.† (AS)

G0251.d: ἅλς, ἁλός, ὁ variant for ἅλας (which see): Mrk.9:49, Rec. WH, mg., R, mg.† (AS)

G0254.d: ἅλυσις, -εως, ἡ a chain, bond: Mrk.5:3-4, Luk.8:29, Act.12:6-7 21:33 28:20, Eph.6:20, 2Ti.1:16, Rev.20:1.† (AS)

G0256.d: Ἀλφαῖος (WH, Ἀλ-), -ου, ὁ (Aram. חַלְפַּי) Alphæus. __1. Father of Levi: Mrk.2:14. __2. Father of James: Mat.10:3, Mrk.3:13, Luk.6:15, Act.1:13.† (AS)

G0257.d: ἅλων, -ωνος (for Attic ἅλως, -ω, see MM, VGT, see word), ἡ, a threshing floor: Mat.3:12, Luk.3:17 (here prob. by meton. = the grain on the threshing floor).† (AS)

G0258.d: ἀλώπηξ, -εκος, ἡ a fox: Mat.8:20, Luk.9:58; metaphorically, of Herod, Luk.13:32.† (AS)

G0260.d: ἅμα adv., at once (Lat. simul): Act.24:26 27:40, Rom.3:12 (one and all = יַחַד, Psa.14:3), Col.4:3, 1Ti.5:13, Phm 22; before σύν, 1Th.4:17 5:10; as prep. with dative, together with: Mat.13:29 (see MM, VGT, see word); also, with adv., ἅ. πρωΐ (cl., ἅ. ἕω, etc.), early in the morning: Mat.20:1.† (AS)

G0261.d: ἀμαθής, -ές (μανθάνω), [in Sm.: Psa.49:11 * ;] unlearned, ignorant: 2Pe.3:16 (on the rareness of this word, see MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

G0263.d: ἀμάραντος, -ον (μαραίνομαι), un­fading (whence ὁ ἀ., the amaranth, an unfading flower): 1Pe.1:4 (cf. MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

G0264.d: ἁμαρτάνω (present formed from aor. ἁμαρτεῖν), __1. to miss the mark (Hom., Æsch., al.), hence metaphorically (Hom., al.), to err, do wrong __2. In LXX and NT, to violate God's law, to sin (for non-Christian exx., see MM, VGT, see word): absol., Mat.18:25 27:4, Luk.17:3, Jhn.5:14 8:11 9:2-3 Rom.2:12 3:23 5:12, 14 5:16 6:15, 1Co.7:28 7:36 15:34, Eph.4:26, 1Ti.5:20, Tit.3:11, Heb.3:17 10:26,…

G0265.d: ἁμάρτημα, -τος, τό (ἁμαρτεῖν, see supr.), an act of disobedience to divine law (Lft., Notes, 273), a sinful deed, a sin: Mrk.3:28-29, Rom.3:25, 1Co.6:18, 2Pe.1:9, WH, mg.; αἰώνιωv ἀ. (DCG, i, 788a), Mrk.3:29 (for exx. from π., see MM, VGT, see word).† SYN.: ἀγνόημα, ἁμαρτία, ἀνομία, ἀσέβεια, ἥττημα, παράβασις, παρακοή, παρανομία, παράπτωμα (ν. Cremer, 100; Tr., Syn., § lxvi; DB, iv, 532; DCG,…

G0266.d: ἁμαρτία, -ας, ἡ (ἁμαρτάνω, which see), prop. a missing the mark; in cl. (see reff. to CR in MM, VGT, see word); __(a) guilt, sin (Plat., Arist., al.); __(b) more freq., from Æsch. down, a fault, failure. In NT (as LXX) always in ethical sense; __1. as a principle and quality of action, = τὸ ἁμαρτάνειν, a sinning, sin: Rom.5:12, 13 20; ὑφ᾽ ἁμαρτίαν εἶναι, Rom.3:9; ἐπιμένειν, Rom.6:1; ἀποθνήσκειν,…

G0268.d: ἁμαρτωλός, -όν (ἁμαρτάνω), sinful, a sinner: of all men, 1Ti.1:15; of those especially wicked, 1Ti.1:9, 1Pe.4:18; p1., Mat.9:10-13 11:19 26:45, al. (see MM, VGT, see word; Cremer, 102, 634) (AS)

G0269.d: ἄμαχος, -ον (μάχη); __1. invincible (frequently in cl.). __2. abstaining from fighting, non-combatant (Xen.). Metaphorical (cf. MM, VGT, see word), not contentious: 1Ti.3:3, Tit.3:2.† (AS)

G0270.d: ἀμάω, -ῶ (in cl. chiefly poët.), to reap: Jas.5:4.† (AS)

G0271.d: ἀμέθυστος, -ου, ἡ (accusative to Plut., ἀ- μεθύω, being regarded as an antidote against drunkenness) amethyst, a purple quartz: Rev.21:20.† (AS)

G0272.d: ἀμελέω, -ῶ (μέλει), __(a) absol., to be careless, not to care: Mat.22:5; __(b) with genitive, to be careless of, to neglect: 1Ti.4:14, Heb.2:3 8:9 (see MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

G0273.d: ἄ-μεμπτος, -ον (μέμφομσι), blameless, free from fault (in π. of a marriage-contract; M, Th., I, 3:13; cf. MM, VGT, see word): Luk.1:6, Php.2:15 3:6, 1Th.3:13 (WH, mg., -ως) Heb.8:7.† SYN.: ἄμωμος, ἀνέγκλητος, ἀνεπίλημπτος, which see (Tr., Syn., § ciii) (AS)

G0274.d: ἀ-μέμπτως, adv. (ἄμεμπτος), blamelessly (Lft., Notes, 28, 89; MM, VGT, see word -ος): 1Th.2:10 3:13 WH mg., 5:23.† (AS)

G0275.d: ἀμέριμνος, -ον (μέριμνα), free from anxiety or care: Mat.28:14, 1Co.7:32 (for exx., see MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

G0276.d: ἀ-μετάθετος, -ον (μετατίθημι), immutable: Heb.6:18; as subat., τὸ ἀ., immutability, Heb.6:17 (see MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

G0278.d: ἀ-μεταμέλητος, -ον (μεταμέλομαι), not repented of, unregretted: Rom.11:29, 2Co.7:10.† (AS)

G0279.d: ἀμετανόητος, -ον (μετανοέω) __1. impenitent: Rom.2:5 __2. = ἀμεταμέλητος (π., Philo, al.; see Deiss., BS, 257; MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

G0280.d: ἄμετρος, -ον (μέτρον), without measure: adverbially, εἰς τὰ ἄ., excessively, 2Co.10:13 10:15† (AS)

G0281.d: ἀμήν, indecl. (Heb. אָמֵן, verbal adj. fr. אמן, to prop. ni., be firm), __1. As adj. (cf. Is, l.with), ὁ ἀ., Rev.3:14. __2. As adv., __(a) in solemn assent to the statements or prayers of another (Nu, Ne, etc., ll. with): ὁ ἀ., 1Co.14:16; __(b) similarly, at the end of one's own prayer or ascription of praise: Rom.1:25 15:33, Gal.1:5, 1Ti.1:17; __(with) in the Gospels, exclusively, introducing…

G0282.d: ἀμήτωρ, -ορος, ὁ, ἡ (μήτηρ), without a mother (frequently in Gk. writers of the gods): ἀπάτωρ ἀ. of one without recorded genealogy, Heb.7:3 (cf. MM, VGT, see word) (AS)

G0283.d: ἀ-μίαντος, -ον (μιαίνω), undefiled, free from contamination (in π., of αἰθήρ; MM, VGT, see word): Heb.7:26 13:4, 1Pe.1:4, Jas.1:27.† SYN.: ἄμωμος, ἄσπιλος (Cremer, 784) (AS)

G0284.d: Ἀμιναδάβ, ὁ indecl. (Heb עַמִּינָדָב), Amminadab: Mat.1:4, Luk.3:33 (WH om.).† (AS)

G0285.d: ἄμμος, -ου, ἡ sand, sandy ground: Mat.7:26, Rom.9:27, Heb.11:12, Rev.18:1, Rev.20:8.† (AS)

G0286.d: ἀμνός, -οῦ, ὁ a lamb: figuratively, of Christ (DCG, ii, 620b), Jhn.1:29, 36, Act.8:32" (LXX), 1Pe.1:19 (cf. ἀρνίον; Cremer, 102, 635).† (AS)

G0287.d: ἀμοιβή, -ῆς, ἡ (ἀμείβομαι, to repay); [in Aq., Sm.: Pro.12:14, al. ;] requital, recompense: 1Ti.5:4 (for illustration from τ.. see MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

G0288.d: ἄμπελος, -ου, ἡ vine: Mat.26:29, Mrk.14:25, Luk.22:18 Jas.3:12; figuratively, of Christ, Jhn.15:1, 4-5; of his enemies (on the usage here, see MM, VGT, see word): Rev.14:18-19.† (AS)

G0289.d: ἀμπελουργός, -οῦ, ὁ, ἡ a vine dresser: Luk.13:7.† (AS)

G0290.d: ἀμπελών, -ῶνος, ὁ (ἄμπελος), a vineyard: Mat.20:1 ff. Mat.21:28 ff, Luk.13:6 20:9 ff., 1Co.9:7. Æschin., 49, 13; Diod., al.; see MM, VGT, see word; LS, see word ἀμπελουργεῖον.) (AS)

G0291.d: Ἀμπλιᾶτος (T, -ίατος; Rec. Ἀμπλιᾶς; see MM, VGT, 5.see), -ου, ὁ Ampliatus: Rom.1:6 8:8.† (AS)

G0292.d: ἀμύνω to ward off, etc. Mid. __(a) to defend oneself against; __(b) to requite; __(with) = act., to defend, assist (Isa, l.with): with accusative of person(s), Act.7:24 (MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

G0293.d: ἀμφίβληστρον, -ου, τό (ἀμφιβάλλω), something thrown around, as a garment; spec., a casting-net: Mat.4:18.† (AS)

G0294.d: ἀμφιέννυμι (ἕννυμι, to clothe), to clothe: Mat.6:30 11:8, Luk.7:25 (cf. ἀμφιάζω).† (AS)

G0295.d: Ἀμφίπολις, -εως, ἡ Amphipolis, in Macedonia, so called because the river Strymon flowed around it: Act.17:1.† (AS)

G0296.d: ἄμφοδον, -ου, το (ἀμφί ὁδός), prop., a road around anything (RV, the open street): Mrk.11:4, Act.19:28, WH, mg.† (AS)

G0297.d: ἀμφότεροι, -αι, -α (replaces ἄμφω in κοινή, V. M, Pr., 57; used of more than two, Pr., 80; MM, VGT, see word), both of two: Mat.9:17, al. (AS)

G0298.d: ἀ-μώμητος, -ου (μωμάομαι), blameless: 2Pe.3:14.† SYN.: ἄμεμπτος (which see), ἀνέγκλητος, ἀνεπίλημπτος (AS)

G0299.d: ἄ-μωμος, -ον (μῶμος, which see), ; of sacrificial victims, without blemish: of Christ, Heb.9:14, 1Pe.1:19; etbically, unblemished, faultless: Eph.1:4 5:27, Php.2:15, Col.1:22, Ju 24, Rev.14:5 (Cremer, 425, 788; MM, VGT, see word).† SYN.: ἀμίαντος, ἄσπιλος (AS)

G0300.d: Ἀμών, ὁ indecl. (Heb. אָמוֹן), Amon, King of Judah: Mat.1:10 (Rec.).† (AS)

G0301G.d: Ἀμώς, ὁ indecl. (Heb. אָמוֹץ, Isa.1:1; עָמוֹס, Amo.1:1; אָמוֹן, 4Ki.21:18 ff. B) __1. as in 2Ki, Lc. B (Α. Ἀμμών; Jos., Ἀμμών, "Αμωσσς), Amon: Mat.1:10. __2. Amos: Luk.3:25.† (AS)

G0302.d: ἄν, conditional particle, which cannot usually be separately translated in English, its force depending on the constructions which contain it (see further, LS, see word; WM, §xlii; M, Pr., 165 ff.; MM, VGT, see word). __1. In apodosis, __(i) with indic, imperfect or aor., expressing what would be or would have been if (εἰ with impf., aor. or plpf.) some condition were or had been fulfilled:…

G0303.d: ἀνά prep. (the rarest in NT; M, Pr., 98; MM, VGT, see word), prop., upwards, up, always with accusative __1. In phrases: ἀ. μέσον, among, between, with genitive, Mat.13:1-58 25:1-46, Mrk.7:31, 1Co.6:5 (M, Pr., 99), Rev.7:17 [so in LXX for בְּתוׄך׃]; ἀ. μέρος, in turn, 1Co.14:27 (both found in Polyb.; cf. MGr. ἀνάμεσα). __2. Distrib., apiece, by: Mat.20:9-10, Luk.9:3 (WH om.), Luk.9:14 Luk.10:1,…

G0304.d: ἀνα-βαθμός, -οῦ, ὁ (ἀναβαίνω), __1. a going up, an ascent (Pss, ll. with ?). __2. a step (LXX); p1., a flight of stairs: Act.21:35, 40. (On the formation -θμός, see MM, VGT, see word)† (AS)

G0305.d: ἀναβαίνω to go up, ascend, __(a) of persons: ἐπί συκομωρέαν, Luk.19:4; εἰς τ. πλοῖον, Mrk.6:51; εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα, Mat.20:17; εἰς τ. ἱερόν, with inf. (M, Pr., 205), Luk.18:10; with mention of place of departure, Mat.3:16 (ἀπό), Act.8:39 (ἐκ); __(b) of things, to rise, spring up, come up: a fish, Mat.17:27; smoke, Rev.8:4; plants growing, Mat.13:7; metaphorically, of things coming up in one's mind…

G0306.d: ἀνα-βάλλω to defer, put off (MM, VGT, see word): mid., Act.24:22.† (AS)

G0307.d: ἀνα-βιβάζω (causal of ἀναβαίνω), to make go up, draw up, as a ship (Xen.): σαγήνην, Mat.13:48 (metaphorically, MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

G0308.d: ἀνα-βλέπω __1. to look up: Mrk.8:24, al.; before εἰς, Mat.14:19, al. (Xen., Plat.). __2. to recover sight (Plat., Aristoph.; cf. MM, VGT, see word): Mat.11:5, Jhn.9:11, al (AS)

G0309.d: ἀνά-βλεψις, -εως, ή (ἀναβλέπω), recovery of sight: Luk.4:18 (Lxx).† (AS)

G0310.d: ἀνα-βοάω, -ῶ to cry out: Mat.27:46 (WH, ἐβόησεν; see MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

G0311.d: ἀναβολή, - ῆς, ἡ (ά αβάλλω), delay: Act.25:17 (for exx. of other meanings, see MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

G0312.d: ἀν-αγγέλλω __1. to bring back word, report (Æsch., Thuc., al.): Jhn.5:15 (WH, εἶπεν), Act.14:27 15:4, 2Co.7:7 __2. Later, = ἀπαγγέλλω (MM, VGT, see word), to announce, declare (LXX; Cremer, 24): Mat.28:11 (WH, ἀπ-), Jhn.4:25 16:13-15, Act.19:18 20:20, 27 Rom.15:21, 1Pe.1:12, 1Jn.1:5.† (AS)

G0313.d: ἀνα-γεννάω, -ῶ to beget again: metaphorically, of spiritual birth, 1Pe.1:3 1:23 (cf. Cremer, 147; MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

G0314.d: ἀνα-γινώσκω (Attic ἀναγιγν-), __1. to know certainly, know again, recognize. __2. Of written characters, to read: Mat.24:15, Mrk.13:14, Act.15:31 23:34, Eph.3:4; with accusative of thing(s), Mat.22:31, Mrk.12:10 Luk.6:3, Jhn.19:20, Act.8:30, 32, 2Co.1:13, Rev.1:3; with accusative of person(s), Ἠσαίαν τ. προφήτην, Act.8:28, 30; before ἐν, Mat.12:5 21:42, Mrk.12:26 (so. ἐν τ. νόμῳ), Luk.10:26;…

G0315.d: ἀναγκάζω (ἀνάγκη), to necessitate, compel by force or persuasion, constrain: with accusative, 2Co.12:11; id. with inf., Mat.14:22, Mrk.6:45, Luk.14:23, Act.26:11 (on the imperfect here, see Field, Notes, 141; M, Pr., 128 f., 247), Gal.2:14 6:12; pass., C. inf., Act.28:19, Gal.2:3 (for exx., see MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

G0316.d: ἀναγκαῖος, -αῖα, -αῖον (ἀνάγκη), __1. necessary: Act.13:46, 1Co.12:22, 2Co.9:5, Php.2:25, Tit.3:14, Heb.8:3; comp. -αιότερον, Php.1:24. __2. Of persons connected by bonds of nature or friendship, near, intimate (Field, Notes, 118; ΜΜ, VGT, see word): ἀ. φίλοι, Act.10:24.† (AS)

G0317.d: ἀναγκαστῶς adv., necessarily or by constraint: opposite to ἑκουσίως, 1Pe.5:2 (rare).† (AS)

G0318.d: ἀνάγκη, -ης, ἡ __1. necessity: ἔχειν ἀ-, with inf., to be compelled, Luk.14:18 23:17 (Rec., R, mg.), 1Co.7:37, Ju 3, Heb.7:27; ἐξ ἀ., κατ᾽ ἀ., of necessity, 2Co.9:7, Heb.7:12, Phm 14; ἀ. μοι ἐπίκειται, n. is laid on me, 1Co.9:16; with inf. (= ἀναγκαῖον ἐστι), Mat.18:7, Rom.13:5, Heb.9:16, 23 __2. force, violence, hence pain, distress (Diod., al.; LXX; see M, Th., 41; MM, VGT, see word; cf.…

G0319.d: ἀνα-γνωρίζω to recognize: Act.7:13 (WH, txt., ἐγνωρίσθη).† (AS)

G0320.d: ἀνά-γνωσις, -εως, ἡ __1. recognition (Hdt.). __2. reading (Plat., al.): of the public reading of Scripture (Milligan, NTD, 173, 210 f.): Act.13:15, 2Co.3:14, 1Ti.4:13 (Cremer, 158; MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

G0321.d: ἀν-άγω to lead or bring up: before είς, with accusative loc., Mat.4:1, Luk.2:22 4:5 (WH om. είς, κ.τ.λ.), Act.9:39 16:34; of raising the dead (cl.), ἐκ νεκρῶν, Rom.10:7, Heb.13:20; to produce and set before, τ. λαῷ, Act.12:4 (MM, VGT, see word); in sacrificial sense (MM, 1 with), to offer, θυσίαν, Act.7:41. Mid., in nautical sense (Hom., Hdt., Thuc., al.), to put to sea: Luk.8:22, Act.13:13 16:11…

G0322.d: ἀνα-δείκνυμι __1. to lift up and show, show forth, declare (cf. 2Ma.2:8, see MM, VGT, see word): Act.1:24. __2. to consecrate, set apart, (Strab., Plut., Anth.): Luk.10:1.† (AS)

G0323.d: ἀνά-δειξις, -εως, ἡ (ἀναδείκνυμι), a sheaving forth, announcement: Luk.1:80.† (AS)

G0324.d: ἀνα-δέχομαι __1. to assume, undertake (in π. frequently as legal term: MM, VGT, see word): ἐπαγγελίας, Heb.11:17. __2. = cl. ὑποδέχομαι, to receive: of guests, Act.28:7.† (AS)

G0325.d: ἀνα-δίδωμι __1. to give forth, send up, as of plants (Hdt., al.). __2. to give up, yield, hand over (MM, VGT, see word): Act.23:33.† (AS)

G0326.d: ἀνα-ζάω, -ῶ [in Al.: Gen.45:27 * ;] to live again, regain life (cf. cl. ἀναβιόω; Cremer, 722; and for other exx., v MM, VGT, see word): metaphorically of moral revival, Luk.15:24 (WH, mg., ἔζησεν); of sin, Rom.7:9.† (AS)

G0327.d: ἀνα-ζητέω, -ῶ to look for or seek carefully ("specially of searching for human beings, with an implication of difficulty": MM, VGT, see word): Luk.2:44-45 Act.11:25.† (AS)

G0328.d: ἀνα-ζώννυμι to gird up: figuratively, τ. ὀσφύας τ. διανοίας, 1Pe.1:13.† (AS)

G0329.d: ἀνα-ζωπυργέω, -ῶ (ζωός, πῦρ), to kindle afresh: metaphorically, 2Ti.1:6 (for vernac. exx., see MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

G0330.d: ἀνα-θάλλω (θάλλω, to flourish), to revive: Php.4:10 (of MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

G0331.d: ἀνάθεμα, -τος, τό (ἀνατίθημι), Hellenistic for Attic ἀνάθημα (Bl., § 27, 2); __1. prop. = τὸ ἀνατιθέμένον, that which is laid by to be kept, a votive offering (as ἀνάθημα in 2Ma.2:13, Luk.21:5—where LT read -θεμα, see M, Pr., 46). __2. [As equiv. in LXX for חֵרֶם,] devoted, a thing devoted to God (see Driver, De., 98 f., and cf. Lev.27:28-29), hence; __(a) of the sentence pronounced (Deu.13:15),…

G0332.d: ἀνα-θεματίζω (ἀνίθεμα), to devote to destruction, declare or invoke ana­thema: absol., Mrk.14:71; ἐαντόν, to bind oneself under a curse: Act.23:12, 14 23:21 (cf. καταναθεματίζω, and on the occurrence of the word in π., see Deiss., LAE, 92 f.; MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

G0333.d: ἀνα-θεωρέω, -ῶ to observe carefully, consider well: Act.17:23, Heb.13:7 (Diod., al.).† (AS)

G0334.d: ἀνάθημα, -τος, τό (cf. ἀνάθημα, and see MM, VGT, see word), a gift set up in a temple, a votive offering: Luk.21:5 (LT, -θεμα).† (AS)

G0335.d: ἀναιδία (Rec. -εία, as in cl.), -ας, ἡ (αἰδώς), shamelessness, importunity: Luk.11:8 (for exx. from π., see MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

G0336.d: ἀν-αίρεσις, -εως, ἡ (ἀναιρέω), __1. a taking up or away (Thuc.). __2. a destroying, slaying, murder (Field, Notes, 116; MM, VGT, see word): Act.8:1.† (AS)

G0348.d: 1. to drive back , (Odyssey by Homer) 2. to beat back an assailant, (Thucydides) 3. to stop:—; Pass. to be stopped, stop short , τινός from a thing, (Lucian) (ML)

G0349.d: ἀνα-κράζω to cry out, shout: Mrk.1:23 6:49, Luk.4:33 8:28 23:18.† (AS)

G0356.d: ἀναλογία, -ας, ἡ (λόγος), [in Al.: Lev.27:1-34"18 * ;] proportion (MM, VGT, see word): Rom.12:6 (cf. Cremer, 397).† (AS)

G0358.d: ἄναλος, -ον (ἅλς), [in Aq.: Eze.13:10-11, 15 22:28 * ;] saltless, insipid: Mrk.9:50.† (AS)

G0359.d: ἀνά-λυσις, -εως, ἡ (ἀναλύω), a loosing, e.g. of a vessel from its moorings, hence, departure: from life, 2Ti.4:6.† (AS)

G0365.d: ἀνα-νεόω, -ῶ (νέος), to renew: pass., Eph.4:23 (see Cremer, 428; MM, VGT, see word)† (AS)

G0513.d: αξίνη, -ης, ἡ an axe: Mat.3:10, Luk.3:9.† (AS)

G0514.d: ἄξιος, -α, -ον (ἄγω, in sense, to weigh), __1. Part One __(a) of weight, worth (often with genitive, cf. Pr 315, 811), before πρός: Rom.8:18 (see Field, Notes, 157); __(b) befitting, meet: with genitive, Mat.3:8, Luk.3:8 23:41, Act.26:20, 1Co.16:4 (see M, Pr., 216); absol., 2Th.1:3; __(with) of persons, worthy; __2. Part Two __α in good sense: with genitive of thing(s), Mat.10:10, Luk.7:4 10:7,…

G0515.d: ἀξιόω, -ῶ (ἄξιος), __(a) to deem worthy: with accusative and inf. (see MM, VGT, see word, and cf. κατ-αξιόω), Luk.7:7; id. and genitive of thing(s), 2Th.1:11; pass. with genitive of thing(s), 1Ti.5:17, Heb.3:3 10:29 __(b) to think fit: with inf. (see M, Pr., 205), Act.15:38 28:22.† (AS)

G0516.d: ἀξίως, adv. worthily: Rom.16:2, Eph.4:1, Php.1:27; with genitive (frequently in Inscr.; Deiss., BS, 248; MM, VGT, 51), ἀ. τ. Κυρίου, Col.1:10; τ. θεοῦ 1Th.2:12, 3Jn.6.† (AS)

G0517.d: ἀόρατος, -ον (ὁράω), unseen, invisible: Rom.1:20, Col.1:15-16, 1Ti.1:17, Heb.11:27.† (AS)

G0518.d: ἀπ-αγγέλλω of a messenger, speaker, or writer, to report, announce, declare: with accusative of thing(s), Act.4:23, al.; with dative of person(s), Mat.2:8, al.; before ὃτι, Luk.18:37; πῶς, Luk.8:36; περί, Luk.7:18 13:1, Act.28:21, 1Th.1:9; λέγων, Act.22:26; with accusative and inf., Act.12:14; before εἰς, Mrk.5:14, Luk.8:34 (MM, VGT, see word; Cremer, 25) (AS)

G0519.d: ἀπ-άγχω (ἄγχω, to press, strangle), to strangle; mid., to hang oneself (or, to choke; see M, Pr., 155): Mat.27:5.† (AS)

G0520.d: ἀπ-άγω to lead away: Luk.13:15, Act.23:17 24:7 (R, mg.), 1Co.12:2; esp. of leading to trial (so as law term in Attic), prison and death (MM, VGT, see word): Mat.26:57 27:2, 31, Mrk.14:44, 53 15:16, Luk.21:12 22:66 23:26, Act.12:19; of the direction of a way: Mat.7:13-14 (cf. συν-απ-άγω).† (AS)

G0522.d: ἀπ-αίρω to lift off, hence, to take away; pass.: Mat.9:15, Mrk.2:20, Luk.5:35.† (AS)

G0523.d: ἀπ-αιτέω, -ῶ to ask back, demand back: Luk.6:30 12:20 (MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

G0524.d: ἀπ-αλγέω, -ῶ __1. prop., to cease to feel pain for (Thuc., ii, 61). __2. In late Gk. __(a) to despair (Polyb., i, 35, 5); __(b) to become callous, reckless (Polyb., xvi, 12, 7; MM, VGT, see word): Eph.4:19.† (AS)

G0525.d: ἀπ-αλλάσσω to remove, release: Heb.2:15; pass., to depart: Act.19:12; in legal sense (MM, VGT, see word), before ἀπό, with genitive of person(s), to be quit of: Luk.12:58 (Cremer, 90, 632).† (AS)

G0526.d: ἀπ-αλλοτριόω, -ῶ to alienate, estrange; pass.: Eph.2:12 4:18, Col.1:21 (MM, VGT, see word; Cremer, 95, 633).† (AS)

G0528.d: ἀπαντάω, -ῶ __1. to go to meet. __2. to meet; with dative: Mrk.14:13, Luk.17:12 (WH, mg., ὑπ-; in Rec. frequently as see1. for ὑπ-, which see).† (AS)

G0529.d: ἀπάντησις, -εως, ἡ (ἀπαντάω), usually with seel., ὑπ-; a meeting; εἰς ἀ., with genitive or dative, to meet: Mat.25:6 27:32 (WH, txt., omits), Act.28:15, 1Th.4:17 (see M, Th., in l; M, Pr., 14, 242; MM, VGT, see word; Lft., Notes, 69).† (AS)

G0530.d: ἅπαξ adv., __(a) once: 2Co.11:25, Heb_9:26-27; ἔτι ἅ., Heb.12:26-27; ἅ. τ. ἐνιαυτοῦ, Heb.9:7; καί ἅ. κ. δίς, twice: Php.4:16, 1Th.2:18; __(b) once for all: Heb.6:4 9:28 10:2, 1Pe.3:18, Ju 3 5 (MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

G0530 G1551.d: ἅπαξ adv., __(a) once: 2Co.11:25, Heb_9:26-27; ἔτι ἅ., Heb.12:26-27; ἅ. τ. ἐνιαυτοῦ, Heb.9:7; καί ἅ. κ. δίς, twice: Php.4:16, 1Th.2:18; __(b) once for all: Heb.6:4 9:28 10:2, 1Pe.3:18, Ju 3 5 (MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

G0531.d: ἀ-παρά-βατος, -ον (παραβαίνω), inviolable, and so unchangeable: Heb.7:24 (see Westc., in l; Cremer, 653; MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

G0533.d: ἀπ-αρνέομαι (-οῦμαι) depon., to deny, i.e. to refuse to recognize, to ignore: with accusative, of oneself (DCG, ii, 598 f.), Mat.16:24, Mrk.8:34 (MM, VGT, see word), Luk.9:23 (WH, mg., txt., ἀρν-) of Peter's denials of Christ, Mat.26:34-35, 75, Mrk.14:30-31, 72, Luk.22:34, 61; pass., Luk.12:9 (Cremer, 111).† (AS)

G0535.d: ἀπαρτισμός, -οῦ, ὁ (ἀπαρτίζω, to finish), completion: Luk.14:28 (cf. MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

G0536.d: ἀπ-αρχή, -ῆς, ἡ (ἀπάρχομαι, to make a beginning in sacrifice, offer first fruits) __1. the beginning of a sacrifice. __2. first fruits: τοῦ φυράματος (cf. Num.15:20), Rom.11:16. Metaphorical, ἀ. τοῦ πνεύματος: Rom.8:23; of Christians: Rom.16:5, 1, 1Co.16:15, 2Th.2:13 (WH, mg., R, mg., txt., ἀπ᾽ ἀρχῆς; see Lft., Notes, 119 f.), Jas.1:18, Rev.14:4; of Christ: 1Co.15:20 15:23 (Cremer, 117; MM, VGT,…

G0537.d: ἅπας, -ασα, -αν (strengthened form of πᾶς, see: ἅ-), all, the whole, altogether: bef. subst. with art., as Luk.3:21; or after, as Mrk.16:15]; absol., in masc., as Luk.5:26; in neut., as Act.2:44; ἅ. οὗτοι, Act.2:7 (LT); ἅ. ὑμεῖς, Gal.3:28 (TTr.). Most frequently in Lk, Ac (see MM, VGT, see word) (AS)

G0538.d: ἀπατάω, -ῶ (ἀπάτη), to deceive: with accusative, Jas.1:26; with accusative of person(s), dative of thing(s), Eph.5:6; pass., 1Ti.2:14 (on its infrequency in late writers, see MM, VGT, see word; cf. ἐξαπατάω).† (AS)

G0539.d: ἀπάτη, -ης, ἡ deceit, deceitfulness: Col.2:8; τοῦ πλούτου, Mat.13:22, Mrk.4:19 (MM, VGT, see word); τῆς ἀδικίας, 2Th.2:10; τῆς ἁμαρτίας, Heb.3:13; αἱ ἐπιθυμίαι τῆς ἀ., Eph.4:22. pl., ἀπά ται (see M, Th., i.e.; NTD, 75; MM, l.with): 2Pe.2:13 (WH, mg., R., txt., ἐν ἀγάπαις).† (AS)

G0540.d: ἀπάτωρ, -ορος, ὁ, ὴ (ἀ- neg., πατήρ) __1. fatherless. __2. without father (MM, VGT, see word), i.e., with no recorded genealogy: Heb.7:3.† (AS)

G0541.d: ἀπ-αύγασμα, -τος, τό (αὐγή, brightness, whence ἀπαυγάζω, to radiate or reflect) of light beaming from a luminous body, radiance, effulgence: Heb.1:3.† (AS)

G0542.d: ἀπ-εῖδον (WH, ἀφ-, ν. Bl., § 4, 3), 2 aor. without present in use (cf. εἶδον), serving as aor. to ἀφοράω, q.v (AS)

G0543.d: ἀπείθεια (WH, -θία, exc. Heb.11:1-40. with), -ας, ἡ (ἀπειθής), disobedience (MM, VGT, see word): Rom.11:30, 32, Heb.4:6, 11; υἱοὶ τῆς ἀ. (genitive of definition, see M, Pr., 73 f.), Eph.2:2 5:6, Col.3:6 (T, WH R, mg., omit).† (AS)

G0544.d: ἀπειθέω, -ῶ (ἀπειθής), as in cl. (MM, VGT, see word); to disobey, be disobedient: absol., Act.14:2 19:9, Rom.10:21 11:31 15:31, Heb.3:18 11:31, 1Pe.3:20; with dative, Jhn.3:36, Rom.2:8 11:30, 1Pe.2:8 3:1 4:17 (Cremer, 475).† (AS)

G0545.d: ἀπειθής, -ές (πείθομαι), disobedient: absol., Luk.1:17, Tit.1:16 3:3; with dative, Act.26:19, Rom.1:30, 2Ti.3:2.† (AS)

G0546.d: ἀπειλέω, -ῶ (ἀπειλή) to threaten: 1Pe.2:23; mid., Act.4:17 (see MM, VGT, see word, and cf. προσαπειλέω).† (AS)

G0547.d: ἀπειλή, -ῆ, ἡ threatening, threat: Act.4:29 9:1, Eph.6:9.† (AS)

G0548.d: ἄπ-ειμι (εἰμί, sum) to be absent: 1Co.5:3, 2Co.10:1 10:11 13:2 13:10 Php.1:27, Col.2:5.† (AS)

G0550.d: ἀπ-εῖπον, 2 aor. without present in use __1. to tell out. __2. to forbid (3Ki.11:2). __3. to renounce: 1 aor. mid. (WH, App., 164; MM, VGT, see word), 2Co.4:2.† (AS)

G0551.d: απείραστος, -ον (πειράζω for cl. ἀπείρητος, πειράω), untempted, untried, without experience: Jas.1:13 (see Hort, in l; MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

G0552.d: ἄπειρος, -ον (ἀ- neg., πεῖρα, trial), without experience of: with genitive of thing(s), Heb.5:13 (MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

G0553.d: ἀπ-εκ-δέχομαι depon., to await or expect eagerly (Lft., Notes, 149; MM, VGT, see word): absol., 1Pe.3:20; C. accusative of thing(s), Rom.8:19, 23 8:25, 1Co.1:7, Gal.5:5; with accusative of person(s), Php.3:20, Heb.9:28.† (AS)

G0554.d: ἀπ-εκ-δύω to strip off clothes or arms; mid., to strip off from oneself: Col.3:9; to strip, despoil (mid, for act., ICC, in l; but cf. Lft., Ellic.), Col.2:15.† (AS)

G0555.d: ἀπ-έκ-δυσις, -εως, ἡ (ἀπεκδύω) a putting or stripping off: Col.2:11 (MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

G0556.d: ἀπ-ελαύνω to drive away: Act.18:16 (MM, see word).† (AS)

G0557.d: ἀπ-ελεγμός, -οῦ, ὁ (ἀπελέγχω, to convict, refute), refutation, disrepute: ἐλθεῖν εἰς ἀ., Act.19:27 (not elsewhere; see MM, see word).† (AS)

G0558.d: ἀπ-ελεύθερος, -ου, ὁ, ἡ a freedman: τ. κυρίου (MM, see word), 1Co.7:22.† (AS)

G0559.d: Ἀπελλῆς, -οῦ, accusative -ῆν (MM, see word), ὁ Apelles: Rom.16:10.† (AS)

G0560.d: ἀπ-ελπίζω __1. to give up in despair, despair of (Polyb., Diod., LXX). __2. to hope to receive from or in return (Field, Notes, 59; Cremer, 712; Soph., Lex., see word): with accusative (M; Pr., 65; MM, see word), Luk.6:35.† (AS)

G0561.d: ἀπ-έναντι adv. with genitive (Hellenistic, common in LXX); __1. over against (MM, see word): Mat.27:61, Mrk.12:41, WH, mg. __2. before, in the presence of: Mat.27:24 (WH, mg.), Act.3:16, Rom.3:18. __3. against: Act.17:7.† (AS)

G0562.d: ἀπέραντος, -ον (περαίνω, to complete, finish) endless, interminable: 1Ti.1:4.† (AS)

G0563.d: ἀπεριστπάστως adv. (περισπάω the adj. occurs in Wis.16:11 Sir.41:1); without distraction: 1Co.7:35.† (AS)

G0564.d: ἀ-περί-τμητος, -ον (περιτέμνω), uncir­cumcised; metaphorically (τ.) καρδίαις (cf. Jer.9:26, al.): Act.7:51 (ἄσημος, found in π., appears to have been the word used by Greek-speaking Egyptians: see Deiss., BS, 153; cf. also Cremer, 885; MM, see word)† (AS)

G0565.d: ἀπέρχομαι, __1. to go away, depart (also, in late writers, with "perfective" force, to arrive at a destination, the thought being carried on to the goal; M, Pr., 111f., 247; MM, see word); __(a) absol.: Mat.13:25, al.; ptcp., ἀπελθών, used pleonastically with other verbs as in Heb. (Dalman, Words, 21), Mat.13:28, al.; __(b) with mention of place or person: εἰς, Mat.14:15; ἐπί, Luk.24:24; πρός,…

G0568.d: ἀπ-έχω __1. trans., __(a) to hold back, keep off; __(b) to have in full, to have received (on the " punctiliar " force of the compound, see M, Pr., 109, 247): with accusative, Mat.6:2, 5 6:16, Luk.6:24, Php.4:18, Phm 15 (for illustr. from π., where it is used in receipts, see Deiss., BS, 229; LAE, 110 f.; MM, see word); impers., ἀπέχει (Field, Notes, 39), it is enough: Mrk.14:41. __2. Intrans.,…

G0569.d: ἀπιστέω, -ῶ (ἄπιστος), __1. to disbelieve, be faithless: Mrk.16:11, 16, Luk.24:11, 41, Act.28:24, 1Pe.2:7; so prob. also Rom.3:3, 2Ti.2:13 (ICC, CGT, in ll; MM, see word). __2. = ἀπειθέω (Hdt.; on this sense in Ro, 2Ti, ll. with, see Vaughan on Ro, l.with; Lft., Notes, 265; Thayer, see word).† (AS)

G0570.d: ἀπιστία, -ας, ἡ (ἄπιστος), want of faith, unbelief: Mat.13:58, Mrk.6:6 9:24 16:14, Rom.3:3 (but see: ἀπιστέω) Rom.4:20 11:20, 23, 1Ti.1:13, Heb.3:12, 19 (DCG, ii, 775a; Cremer, 492).† (AS)

G0571.d: ἄ-πιστος, -ον (ἀ- neg., πιστός) __(a) of things, incredible: Act.26:8; __(b) of persons, without faith or trust, unbelieving: Mat.17:17, Mrk.9:19, Luk.9:41 12:46, Jhn.20:27, Tit.1:15, Rev.21:8; specif., of unbelievers as opposite to Christians: 1Co.6:6 7:12-15 10:27 14:22-24, 2Co.4:4 6:14-15, 1Ti.5:8 (cf. Lft., Notes, 265; Cremer, 491).† (AS)

G0572.d: ἀπλότης, -ητος, ή (ἁπλοῦς), simplicity, sincerity: Rom.12:8, 2Co.11:3, Eph.6:5, Col.3:22; as manifested in generous, unselfish giving, liberality, graciousness: 2Co.8:2 9:11 9:13 (see ICC, Rom.12:8; Hort, Jas.1:5, and see: ἁπλῶς).† (AS)

G0573.d: ἁπλοῦς, -ῆ, -οῦν (contr. fr. -όος; ἁ.- cop., πλόος), simple, single: in a moral sense (DCG, ii, 628 f.), ἀφθαλμός, Mat.6:22, Luk.11:34. (In π. of a marriage dowry, see MM, see word).† ἁπλόος, see: ἁπλοῦς SYN.: ἄδολος, ἄκακος, ἀκέραιος (Tr., Syn., § lvi; Cremer, 107, 639) (AS)

G0574.d: ἁπλῶς adv. (ἁπλοῦς), simply, sincerely, graciously: Jas.1:5. ("Later writers comprehend under the one word the whole magnanimous and honour­able type of character in which ... singleness of mind is the central feature "-Hort, Ja., l.with)† (AS)

G0575.d: ἀπό (on the frequently neglect of elision bef. vowels, see Tdf., Pr., 94, WH, App., 146), prep. with genitive (WM, 462ff.; on its relation to ἐκ, παρά, ὑπό, ib. 456f.), from (i.e. from the exterior). __1. Of separation and cessation; __(1) of motion from a place: Mat.5:29, 30 7:23, Luk.5:2 22:41, al.; __(2) in partitive sense (M, Pr., 72, 102, 245; MM, see word; Bl., §40, 2), Mat.9:16 27:21,…

G0575 G0746.d: ἀπό (on the frequently neglect of elision bef. vowels, see Tdf., Pr., 94, WH, App., 146), prep. with genitive (WM, 462ff.; on its relation to ἐκ, παρά, ὑπό, ib. 456f.), from (i.e. from the exterior). __1. G0575 G4155.d: ἀπό (on the frequently neglect of elision bef. vowels, see Tdf., Pr., 94, WH, App., 146), prep. with genitive (WM, 462ff.; on its relation to ἐκ, παρά, ὑπό, ib. 456f.), from (i.e. from the exterior). __1. G0575/G4155.d: ἀπό (on the frequently neglect of elision bef. vowels, see Tdf., Pr., 94, WH, App., 146), prep. with genitive (WM, 462ff.; on its relation to ἐκ, παρά, ὑπό, ib. 456f.), from (i.e. from the exterior). __1.
